messages:
Alex W.: Quick q — for infra-only changes during a surge window (no code, just tuning autoscale knobs) do we require a patch bump?
Maria P.: my gut: if it changes runtime behavior (batching, memory limits) we should bump. docs/config-only that don't affect binary behavior = skip.
Jen: +1 on that. But we need a clear rule so deploybot doesn't force a bump and block merges at 02:00.
Sam: Deploybot currently watches files under /runtime and /infra-config. If those change it tags patch. That's been noisy.
Alex W.: noisy how?
Sam: e.g., terraform var reorder triggered a patch tag even though it was a metadata change for infra state. caused releasebot to block the deploy until human ack.
Maria P.: hmm. Can we tighten matching? maybe only look for code or config that affects runtime flags (like ENABLE_NEW_BATCHER) vs infra state.
Jen: I'd rather we define a whitelist: paths that must trigger patch bump. everything else -> add to release notes but don't force semver bump.
Release Council: Proposal: patch bump required when: 1) binary-level changes, 2) runtime config flips that alter behavior, 3) compatibility-affecting schema changes. Otherwise allow skip with a changelog entry.
Alex W.: that seems reasonable. How does releasebot detect "runtime config flips"?
Sam: We can pattern-match for files under /runtime/config/*.yml OR env var toggles in deploy manifests. For terraform, only specific variables (eg enable_kv_cache) should trigger.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot here — current rule: any change under /infra-config triggers a candidate patch bump. Suggestion: add exceptions list and a fallback annotation you can add to PR: `skip-patch-check` to force merge without bump.
Maria P.: I dislike ad-hoc skip flags — they get abused. Prefer a FILE-BASED white/blacklist + human review for exceptions.
Jen: compromise: allow `skip-patch-check` but it requires 2 approvers from release council to pass. audit logs recorded.
Alex W.: sounds OK. What about tag format? we're seeing both `v1.2.3+meta` and `1.2.3-build.1` in logs. consistency matters for downstream consumers.
Sam: We currently use SemVer 2.0.0. build metadata should be after `+`. canonical: `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH+buildmeta`. tooling prefers `v` prefix.
Maria P.: agreed. enforce `v` prefix for git tags. buildmeta should be optional and not considered for semver precedence.
Jen: For auto-canary builds, we should append `+canary.TIMESTAMP` and for hotfixes `+hotfix.{owner}`. Keep the core semver unchanged so deploy routing stays stable.
Release Council: Decision: Tags must be `vX.Y.Z` optionally `+meta`. Releasebot will normalize tags on publish.
Alex W.: rollback criteria — if a patch-only release regresses p99 latency by >20% we rollback automatically?
Maria P.: define rollback triggers: a) p95 or p99 increases beyond threshold, b) error rate > 0.5% absolute increase, c) failed healthchecks > 3 consecutive probes. All must be observed for at least 2 minutes to avoid flapping.
Sam: add a circuit-breaker: if rollback happens in canary we don't escalate; if rollback in prod, auto-create a rollback PR and ping #oncall.
Jen: also capture which tag to roll back to — last successful patch on the same minor line. e.g., rolling back v1.4.7 -> v1.4.6; don't jump minors.
Alex W.: good. Anything on release notes?
Maria P.: enforce a changelog entry for every merge. releasebot will refuse to publish a release without a changelog snippet. For skipped-patch merges, changelog must indicate why semver was skipped.
deploy-bot: implemented: will now require a `changelog:` section or a `release-notes.md` entry. Will support `releasebot:skip` annotation but only with 2 RC approvals.
Jen: timeline to ship these rules? can we roll in a gradual way? start with detection + warnings for 2 weeks, then enforce.
Sam: I can get a PR open for the deploybot rule changes today. we can flip to warning mode by adding `--warn-only` and switch to `--enforce` after 14 days.
Release Council: agreed. Action items: Sam open PR for deploybot; Jen create a one-pager for the whitelist; Maria update playbook with rollback thresholds; Alex coordinate rollout window.
Alex W.: awesome — thanks. If anyone hits a merge blocked by releasebot in the next 24h ping me and I'll triage. :pray:
Maria P.: thanks all. :thumbsup:
